tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Search MadMax Trade Supply's in-stock catalog (refrigerator and water filters, HVAC air filters, humidifier pads, sump and septic alarms/parts, radon mitigation parts, batteries, LED bulbs, pool and spa filters) by keyword, OEM part number, filter size (e.g. 16x25x1) or brand. Returns live USD price

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one SKU: price for the ship-to state, shipping, return window, auto-ship options, part numbers it replaces, and an add-to-cart URL.

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Find the replacement we carry for an OEM part number (e.g. WF3CB, XWF, Aprilaire 35, LT700P), a nominal air filter size (e.g. 20x25x4) or a system/model name. Matching is based on our product titles.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Build a pre-filled madmaxsupply.com cart link for the buyer. Does NOT place an order or charge anything: the buyer opens the link, enters the address and pays on Stripe-hosted checkout. Optional auto_ship_months (1, 2, 3, 6 or 12) sets up Subscribe & auto-ship on eligible items.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Product categories with their slugs and page URLs.

tools.name: get_store_policies
tools.description: Shipping, sales tax, payment, returns, subscriptions and contact details for MadMax Trade Supply.
